integrity: The argument uses exact Gram/singular-value reduction and Perron comparison; finite numerical checks are supplementary rather than certificates for all dimensions.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to a single nonzero rank-one block and its adjoint along an open path; no claim for arbitrary rank, cycles, distinct edge blocks, or non-Hilbert numerical radii. Publication priority remains subject to undiscovered broader tensor-operator results. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Orientation-defect rigidity for rank-one block numerical-radius paths
